name: data-table
summary: Renders a responsive, keyboard-scrollable labelled data table with accessible headers and text fixture rows.

agent.useWhen: A result set is best compared across labelled columns; use text fixture rows or have the Native host compose admitted app-owned rich cells.
agent.avoidWhen: The data is better represented as cards, the host cannot prove composed row/cell structure and stable IDs, or the component would need to own application operations.

invariants: Caption is nonblank; 1..=16 nonblank columns and up to 100 fixture rows are admitted.
Text rows must match the column count exactly; optional stable IDs are unique safe tokens; all fixture cells are escaped text.
Column headers use scope=col; the overflow wrapper is tabindex=0 role=region labelled by the caption.
Responsive narrow presentation preserves every cell and column label; first cell spans the row.
Host-composed tbody markup is admitted only after the host proves row/cell structure, labels, budgets, and stable IDs; AdmittedChildren is not a sanitizer.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[caption]], [[head]], and [[body]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

attributes.name: columns
rules: A JSON array of 1..16 nonblank plain-text column labels.

attributes.name: caption-visible
rules: Boolean literal true or false; defaults to false.
Content consists only of table rows and supported template control flow.

attributes.name: id
rules: Use alone, not with id-prefix or key; 1..128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, or colon.

attributes.name: id-prefix
rules: Use together with key and not with id; 1..128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, or colon.

attributes.name: key
rules: Use only with id-prefix; one whole checked field resolving to a string, integer, unsigned integer, or model reference; runtime token is 1..128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, or underscore, with no sanitization.
Choose exactly id OR id-prefix plus key.
Each row has exactly the table's column count in paired, attribute-free cells, with whitespace only between cells.
Do not put conditional control flow around cells; conditionals inside a cell are supported.
The app must provide stable, globally unique emitted IDs. Literal duplicates within this table are rejected; runtime-generated duplicates are not all detected.

Content may contain text, escaped bindings, HTML including registered route links, and nested supported cui-* declarations admitted by the host; this is host admission, not a raw HTML string property.
No colspan or invented sorting or pagination behavior.
The host verifies row and cell structure, labels, budgets, bindings, and stable IDs before admission; package metadata does not grant host capabilities.
No arbitrary raw HTML string properties are supported.

examples.name: rich-customers
examples.summary: Three-column customer results with status badges and an empty state.
examples.template:
{% for customer in customers %} {{ customer.name }}
{{ customer.email }} {% if customer.active %}{% else %}{% endif %} {% if customer.has_scheme %}{% else %}{% endif %} {% else %} —— {% endfor %}
requirements: App provides customers as a list of records: id is a safe token string or checked integer/reference; name and email are strings; active and has_scheme are Bool fields.
Register customer_show route accepting id if using the linked name.
Host admits cui-badge and cui-empty-state in cell content; app provides stable unique customer IDs.
